events.body:
## Context

`scripts/update_slack_apps.py` has pure functions (`merge_apps`, `parse_app_cards`, `_find_apps_in_json`, `_parse_next_data`) with no tests; CI only runs `py_compile` on it. `merge_apps` must keep curated security fields.

## What to do

1. Add `tests/test_update_slack_apps.py` with fixture HTML/JSON.
2. Extend the blt-panini row in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv` with `pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt && python -m unittest discover -s tests`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Merge keeps curated fields and adds new apps with defaults
- [ ] Parser handles card HTML and a `__NEXT_DATA__` blob
- [ ] CI runs the tests

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-panini
```

---
